# ClaudeMC v1.20.3 — all v1.19.6/v1.19.7 fixes ported to Minecraft 1.21.11

Ports every bug fix and quality-of-life improvement from v1.19.6 and v1.19.7 to the Minecraft 1.21.11 build.

## Changes

### Core
- **Category**: Added EXPLOIT, CHAT, UTILITY categories (were already present)
- **ChatSpammer**: Fixed `parseInt` parsing float-encoded values like "200.0"
- **Speed**: Added `onDisable()` to zero horizontal velocity on module disable
- **KillAura**: Respects attack cooldown with FullCharge option; uses typed NumberSetting/BoolSetting fields; proper delay tracking
- **FakePlayer**: Copies equipment slot-by-slot instead of `copyFrom()` to prevent entity state corruption; shows success/failure messages

### Render
- **Radar**: Fixed rotation matrix so "forward" is up on the minimap; replaced self-dot with yellow cross marker; default anchor is BottomRight to avoid overlapping module list
- **ESP/Tracers/BlockScanModule**: Removed `consumers == null` guard that silently aborted rendering
- **Tracers**: Fixed tracer origin to 1 block in front of the camera (prevents camera-clip culling)
- **FreeCam**: Added `noClip = true` on enable and each tick, `noClip = false` on disable so the camera entity passes through walls
- **RenderUtils**: Added `disableDepthTest` / `depthMask` wrapper calls for through-walls ESP visibility (1.21.11 pipeline compatible)

### Input/GUI
- **ScreenMixin**: After ChatOverlay consumes a key, now also calls `cir.cancel()` so vanilla doesn't double-process the key
- **shouldPause() fix**: All GUI screens (MacroScreen, AltScreen, KeybindScreen, ServerInfoScreen, BlockESPScreen, LunarMenuScreen, ClickGui) now override `shouldPause()` returning false instead of the renamed `isPauseScreen()`
- **ClickGui**: Added search bar at top; alphabetical sorting within categories; number settings rendered as sliders with drag support; middle-click shows module description tooltip; 2-row panel layout (row1: COMBAT/MOVEMENT/PLAYER/RENDER/WORLD, row2: EXPLOIT/CHAT/UTILITY/MISC); closes with same keybind that opens it; footer hint updated

### Network
- **Velocity module**: Added `onEntityVelocityUpdate` mixin injection to intercept and scale knockback packets using the H-Mult/V-Mult settings
- **ClientPlayNetworkHandlerMixin**: Added velocity knockback interception

### Companion / UI
- **CompanionServer**: Multi-tier browser launch fallback chain: Desktop.browse → OS ProcessBuilder → common browsers → clipboard copy; runs in virtual thread
- **TitleScreenMixin**: Shows companion URL at screen bottom after clicking the button

### AutoMine
- Added **Layout** setting: Pokehole (default), Branch, Tunnel
- **Pokehole**: digs 1×1 side holes every PokeEvery blocks to PokeDepth depth
- **Safety**: Before stepping forward, checks for floor drops >2 blocks; bridges with hotbar block or turns 90°
- **Bridge**: Places blocks from hotbar when bridging over drops
- **Lava/water avoidance**: Does not mine into fluid blocks; seals adjacent fluids when encountered

### HUD
- **HudManager**: Stats strip (FPS/TPS/Ping) is now draggable via right-click drag

### Settings
- **NumberSetting**: Added slider support methods: `getMin()`, `getMax()`, `isInteger()`, `setFraction()`, `getFraction()`
